· SHELANCER · A FUNNGRO VERTICAL ·

Empowering women to earn & build.

A dedicated vertical for women to earn independently — safe, flexible, and on your own terms. From first income to financial freedom.

Join SheLancer
→
Read SheLancer stories ▸

· WHY SHELANCER ·

Built for the women’s cohort, specifically.
01
Safe & verified

All projects are verified before they go live. Work from home with complete safety, identity protection, and transparency on what you're asked to do.

02
Grow at your pace

Start small, build skills, and progress to higher-earning opportunities. No quotas, no minimum hours. Your journey, your speed.

03
Supportive community

Join thousands of women earning independently and supporting each other. Women-only Clan groups, women-only campaign briefs.

04
Flexible hours

Work when you want, how you want. No fixed schedules, no pressure. Built for women who balance multiple commitments.

· SAME INCOME LADDER · TUNED FOR SHELANCER ·

From your first ₹500 to ₹15,000+ a month.

The Income & Influence Ladder applies on SheLancer too. Same path, women-only campaigns, women-only support.

STAGE 01 · START

Your First Income

Surveys, product reviews, brand recall. Earn from home in your free hours.

₹500–₹3,000/mo

STAGE 02 · GROW

Multiply & Influence

Refer friends, content for women-focused brands, beauty & wellness campaigns.

₹3,000–₹7,000/mo

STAGE 03 · BUILD

Your Own Business

Lead a SheLancer Clan. Manage campaigns. Some women have built full home-based businesses.

₹7,000–₹15,000+/mo

· SHELANCER STORIES ·

Real women. Real earnings.
👩

· WHAT’S DIFFERENT ·

Not just Funngro re-coloured.

SheLancer is a vertical built deliberately for the women’s cohort — with concrete differences from the main app.

DIFFERENCE I

Women-only campaign briefs

Beauty, wellness, fashion, women's health — brands target this cohort specifically.

DIFFERENCE II

Women-only Clan groups

Your community is other women earners. Privacy-first matching.

DIFFERENCE III

Women community moderators

Every SheLancer Clan is moderated by a woman. Safety first, speed second.

DIFFERENCE IV

Flexible payout schedules

Same instant UPI, plus optional weekly digest format for budgeting.

· YOUR INDEPENDENCE STARTS HERE ·

Join thousands of women already earning.

Free forever. Zero fees. Instant UPI. Safe and verified.
